en.t: He immediately came back to reality again.

units.source_text: 这个屋子不能住人，那么，那女人究竟打算睡在哪里呢？

en.t: If this house was unfit to live in, then where on earth did that woman intend to sleep?

units.source_text: 板壁那边频频传来女人颠来跑去的声音。

en.t: From the other side of the board wall came the repeated sounds of the woman hurrying back and forth.

units.source_text: 手表上的指针指着八点零二分。

en.t: The hands of his watch pointed to eight oh two.

units.source_text: 这种时候，她还有什么事可做呢？

en.t: At a time like this, what could she still have to do?
